column1: # The exceptions to the order of an inflected form's articles (site decisions 143): one line per form
# as spelled, the article id(s) whose word goes first (comma-separated, in that order) and why. Read by
# ordpar/build_index.py after E2, the frequency order (each spelling's count in NB's 2026 books shared
# among the articles that have it, by their example sentences + 1); a word named here goes first whole, in
# the list view's order (Robin, 2026-10-27: "within one word the list view's order wins"), the rest keep
# E2's order. The file, its entry count and any line that names no form or article in the index are in
# the index manifest's form_order, and a full build refuses such a line. Robin rules on every entry; an entry is added only
# where a reader would want another article first. Ordpar's own work, CC BY 4.0, like the English.

column3: the noun løp (i løpet av); E2 puts the verb løpe first
